next_step: Re-engage exec sponsor, propose 3-week reduced-scope POC; AE to follow up by 2026-03-20
notes:
POC initiated (Nov 2025) — scope: reranking model + embeddings for product search; 2-week integration window + 1-week validation.

Key timeline (high level):
- 2025-11-12: kickoff (AE Aisha, SE Marcus, Eng lead: Raj B.) — agreed on test queries, sample traffic, success metrics (latency < 120ms p95, improve NDCG by +6%). Fireflies: ff_2025-11-12_polaris_kickoff.
- 2025-11-23: Redwood delivered sandbox endpoints, baseline benchmarks, dev keys. Eng team started light integration (client-side SDK).
- 2025-12-05: First integration sync — engineering reported blocked by internal infra changes; agreed to pause heavy work until Jan. Action: Marcus to provide small test harness and sample scripts.
- 2026-01-06: Security intake opened; Polaris security requested SOC2 evidence, KMS keyflow diagram, data residency mapping. Filed SEC-701.
- 2026-01-15: Mid-POC review — demo showed acceptable relevance gains but latency spike in one route; recommended batching config and smaller model variant. Fireflies: ff_2026-01-15_poc-review.
- 2026-01-29: Polaris engineering hit hiring freeze; redistributed cycles to a payment migration project. POC milestones slipped (no infra time to implement recommended batching).
- 2026-02-10: Polaris procurement puts external vendor spend on temporary freeze (company-wide cost review).
- 2026-02-28: Last substantive contact (CSM Elena): Polaris security reiterated need for proof of encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys and data residency SLA. No engineering PRs merged since Jan.

Current situation / signals:
- Stalled: POC started but missed integration milestones; engineering capacity reallocated.
- Procurement/budget freeze is primary blocker; security gating (KMS + residency) also unresolved.
- Competing pilot: Polaris has a parallel pilot (Anthropic-based reranking) contracted through a channel partner; they indicated faster org-wide sign-off for that vendor.
- Low internal champion momentum — product manager who sponsored POC has moved to another initiative.

Quotes / paraphrases from contacts:
- "We like the results we saw in the demo, latency is the concern and we need a KMS pattern that maps to our PCI controls." — Polaris Security (Jan call)
- "Hiring freeze means we can't commit infra cycles until Q2 hiring re-open. Procurement is frozen for outside vendors above $25k without CFO approval." — Eng lead Raj B.

Attempted plays and outcomes:
- Offered a reduce-scope POC (embeddings-only, hosted endpoints) to cut implementation time — Polaris responded "might be easier" but deprioritized.
- Proposed Redwood-managed KMS PoC notes + draft KMS integration doc; security asked for formal diagrams and compliance attestation (we opened SEC-701).
- AE attempted executive re-introduction (sent intro to VP Product) — no reply.

Next recommended actions (sales ops POV):
- Short-term: Pause active engineering follow-ups; continue light-touch cadence (monthly check-ins).
- Re-engage when procurement signals reopen or when engineering capacity returns.
- Prepare a tight 3-week reduced-scope package (hosted rerank + sample queries + Redwood-managed KMS option) to present to CFO/sponsor to accelerate approval.
- Flag as a recovery/at-risk opportunity in next forecast review; continue monitoring competitor pilot.

Internal notes / red flags for AE/SE:
- Champion risk: product sponsor deprioritized.
- Security asks escalate (SOC2 evidence, KMS ownership, residency) — may require enterprise sales play or Private deployment.
- Potential loss reason: faster procurement path with competitor + internal budget constraints.

Status summary: POC technically promising but stalled. Outcome currently uncertain — classify as evaluation (stalled); follow-up recommended but low near-term conversion probability unless budget/security blocks clear.
